title: Has the SpaceX correction created a buying opportunity? Expert says, ‘stock will be volatile by nature but…’
summary: SpaceX's valuation plummeted by over $600 billion in three days, raising questions among investors about buying opportunities versus warning signs. The stock experienced significant volatility post-IPO, with a substantial one-day decline.
